Site account describes original wooden markers, 1881 mapped cemetery, later 1925 resurvey, 1938 monument and 1944 metal-pipe marker replacements. Supports excluding those later features from an 1881-1883 reconstruction.
Secondary local account corroborates loss of original wooden markers and approximate later replacement positions; not municipal publication.
1947 retrospective describes wooden grave markers and distinct old/new cemeteries. It is later testimony, not an inspected 1880s photograph.
